scope.coverage_note: IOM workbook contains only reported cadasters; geographic polygons for ALL 1627 cadasters must be obtained from the separately cited Lebanon Atlas ADM3 boundary layer. Do not render unreported areas as zero or absent from the map.

source.dataset: Lebanon - IDP Tracking Dataset - Round 119 - 29 October 2026 - Admin3
source.source_workbook: Lebanon - IDP Tracking Dataset - Round 119- 29-10-2026 - Admin3(1).xlsx
source.note: User-provided workbook; public redistribution rights should be verified with IOM

boundary_source.name: Lebanon Atlas – OCHA FISS/CDR-derived ADM2 and ADM3 boundaries
boundary_source.join_rule: Cast both IOM cadaster_pcode (e.g. 62276) and boundary ADM3_CODE to strings before equality join. Check code matches; never match names alone. ADM2 codes may have historical inconsistencies; validate district of each feature.

definitions.idps_hosted: Current IDPs recorded in a hosting cadaster; excludes 11,210 collective-site arrivals from separate Sites sheet.
definitions.idps_origin: Current IDPs by their original district, aggregated across destination cadasters; origin is district-level, not village-level.
definitions.site_idps: Arrivals in collective sites recorded at DISTRICT level, not assignable to a cadastral village.
definitions.returnees: Returnees recorded at destination cadaster; rows may repeat a cadaster by district returned from and are aggregated by P-code.
definitions.not_reported: Null means not included in the supplied table; it must not be displayed as zero.
definitions.accommodation: Hosted equals hosted_with_host plus hosted_without_host; Others * repeats Other, so it is not added again.
definitions.non_additive: Hosting IDPs, origin IDPs, and returnees are different metrics and must never be simply added or subtracted to estimate unmet aid or population.

app_display_rules.district_view: Show all 26 district polygons. Display IDPs hosted, IDPs from this district elsewhere in Lebanon (origin metric), collective-site IDPs where reported, and returnees independently.
app_display_rules.village_view: Show all ADM3 cadastral polygons from boundary source. For areas in this file, attach the IOM measurements; for other areas show not_reported, never zero.
app_display_rules.verified_vs_missing: Missing or absent record is unknown, not a confirmed zero.
app_display_rules.reference_note: Confirm redistribution conditions directly with IOM before publishing externally shared data.
